newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX EUROYEN RISE ON JGB SHORT-COVERING SPREE.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX EUROYEN RISE ON JGB SHORT-COVERING SPREE.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures rose on short-covering in Japanese government bond (JGB) futures amid continued weakness in Nikkei cash and futures markets, dealers said on Thursday.

"We didn't see any news today. Locals were trying to short the market thinking there was no reason for it to go higher but they had to keep covering their positions," said a trader at a Japanese brokerage.
He said the market was lifted by good sized buying interest by an Asian institution in early trade.
"The Japanese economy is still in the doldrums. I would like to be a buyer of March Euroyen around 99.15/16," a trader at a U.S. futures house said.
He said the contract's rise was being blocked by strong selling interest above 99.22. It stood at 99.21 at 1115 GMT after briefly rising to 99.23 against an IMM close at 99.16.
"There was a good rally in the JGBs today," the trader said, September JGBs faced resistance at 126.80 and 127.00. They ended at 126.67 against a previous 126.05, he added.
Eurodollar futures ended slightly firmer ahead of a 30-year note auction, the last leg of the U.S. Treasury Department's quarterly refunding.
December Eurodollars ended at 94.090 against an IMM close at 94.085 on volume of 5,520 lots. March were at 94.015 against 94.000 on 6,000 lots.
